items.what: Two new EU AI Act prohibitions apply: systems that generate child sexual abuse material or non-consensual intimate imagery. Machine-readable marking of synthetic output under Article 50(2) also applies to generative systems already on the market
items.who: Any firm offering generative AI in the EU
items.todo: Confirm your vendors mark synthetic output and that your own builds do too
items.title: EU AI Act: new prohibitions and synthetic-content marking apply

items.what: FINRA's 2027 oversight report, if it follows the 2026 report's release on 9 December 2025
items.todo: Re-read the 2026 report's agent section and check you can track agent actions and decisions
items.title: FINRA 2027 oversight report expected

items.what: Colorado's Automated Decision-Making Technology in Consequential Decisions Act takes effect, replacing the 2024 Colorado AI Act: notice before use, an explanation within 30 days of an adverse outcome, and meaningful human review on request
items.who: Developers and deployers using automated decisions in lending, insurance, employment and other covered areas for Colorado consumers
items.todo: Identify which automated decisions reach Colorado consumers; deployers keep compliance records for three years after each use
items.title: Colorado automated decision-making law takes effect

items.what: The FCA publishes its evaluation of the second AI Live Testing cohort: Aereve, Barclays, Coadjute, Experian, GoCardless, Lloyds Banking Group (Scottish Widows), Palindrome and UBS. Testing ends by the end of 2026
items.todo: Read it for the supervisor's view of production AI in banking, payments and credit data
items.title: FCA evaluation of the second AI Live Testing cohort

items.what: The US banking agencies' request for information on model risk and "banks' use of AI, including generative AI and agentic AI", promised in April when SR 26-2 left both out of scope. Not in the Federal Register as of 24 October 2026
items.todo: Prepare your answer now: how you validate retrieval, guardrails and agent actions, and how you would stop an agent
items.title: US bank regulators' request for information on AI

items.what: A ruling on OpenAI's and Microsoft's summary judgment motions in the news publishers' copyright cases, including New York Times v. OpenAI. The publishers filed their opposition in October 2026; no ruling date has been set
items.who: Anyone training or fine-tuning on third-party content
items.todo: Inventory the provenance of every corpus your models touch
items.title: Ruling on summary judgment in the publishers' copyright cases against OpenAI and Microsoft

items.what: The first lawsuit brought in the name of the DOJ AI Litigation Task Force, created under the executive order of 11 December 2025. The DOJ intervened on 24 April 2026 in xAI's challenge to the 2024 Colorado AI Act, which Colorado then repealed and replaced
items.who: Firms planning around state AI laws
items.todo: Avoid building compliance around any single state regime until this settles
items.title: First DOJ AI Litigation Task Force lawsuit

items.what: General-purpose AI models placed on the EU market before 2 August 2025 must comply; each member state must have at least one operational AI regulatory sandbox
items.who: Model providers directly; firms that fine-tune or rebrand models
items.todo: Ask your model vendors for their compliance position and documentation
items.title: EU AI Act: legacy general-purpose AI models must comply

items.what: EU AI Act high-risk obligations for Annex III systems apply, including creditworthiness and credit scoring of individuals, life and health insurance pricing, and recruitment
items.who: Lenders, insurers and employers using AI in the EU
items.todo: Start conformity and logging work now; deployers must keep logs for at least six months
items.title: EU AI Act: high-risk obligations for Annex III systems

items.what: High-risk obligations for AI built into products regulated under Annex I apply
items.todo: Note it; little action for most financial firms
items.title: EU AI Act: high-risk obligations for Annex I products
